name: jspace
description: JSpace CLI - create and validate local workbenches (bun+TypeScript)

scripts.build: bun run scripts/clean-bun-build.ts && bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && bun run scripts/gen-assets.ts && bun build --compile ./cli/main.ts --minify --outfile bin/jspace && bun run scripts/clean-bun-build.ts
scripts.build:all: bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && bun run scripts/gen-assets.ts && bun run scripts/build-all.ts
scripts.build:win: bun run scripts/clean-bun-build.ts && bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && bun run scripts/gen-assets.ts && bun build --compile ./cli/main.ts --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile bin/jspace-windows-x64.exe && bun run scripts/clean-bun-build.ts
scripts.build:linux: bun run scripts/clean-bun-build.ts && bun run scripts/gen-version.ts && bun run scripts/gen-assets.ts && bun build --compile ./cli/main.ts --minify --target=bun-linux-x64-baseline --outfile bin/jspace-linux-x64 && bun run scripts/clean-bun-build.ts
